note: A curse cast on a target and the enemies around it: their fire resistance falls (25% to 44%). Used by the AI on packs and rare enemies, one curse at a time.

def.name: Tinder Curse
def.description: Curses enemies in an area: they lose fire resistance.

note: A curse that lowers the cold resistance of the enemies it falls on (25% to 44%).

def.name: Rime Curse
def.description: Curses enemies in an area: they lose cold resistance.

note: A curse that lowers the lightning resistance of the enemies it falls on (25% to 44%).

def.name: Static Curse
def.description: Curses enemies in an area: they lose lightning resistance.

note: A curse that lowers chaos resistance (20% to 29%); the extra damage over time taken is folded into the weaker chaos resistance.

def.name: Void Curse
def.description: Curses enemies in an area: they lose chaos resistance.

note: A curse that makes the cursed take more damage from melee hits (modelled as more damage taken of every type).

def.name: Penance
def.description: Curses enemies in an area: they take more damage.

note: A curse that lowers chaos resistance and makes enemies take more damage (the curses it spreads on death are dropped).

def.name: Ruin Ritual
def.description: A ritual that rots a small area: enemies lose chaos resistance and take more damage.

note: A mark: enemies under it take more damage, and the character has more critical strike chance and multiplier against them (the life and mana on kill are dropped).

def.name: Ruin Sigil
def.description: Marks an enemy: it takes more damage and is easier to critically strike.

note: A mark: marked enemies take more damage, and the character gains Fervour charges when they die (the flask charges and life on being hit are dropped).

def.name: Plenty Sigil
def.description: Marks an enemy: killing it may grant a Fervour charge.

note: A mark: the character deals more projectile damage with more accuracy to the marked, which also take more damage.

def.name: Hunt Sigil
def.description: Marks an enemy: your projectiles hit it harder and truer.

note: A mark: the character stuns the marked for longer and leeches life from melee hits on them (the stun recovery malus is folded into the stun duration).

def.name: Warlord Sigil
def.description: Marks an enemy: it stays stunned longer and feeds your melee hits.

note: A warcry cast when a pack or a rare enemy is near: it regenerates life and grants Grit charges (the scaling with nearby enemies is averaged).

def.name: Steadfast Bellow
def.description: A bellow that steadies you: life regeneration, and a Grit charge.

note: A warcry cast when a pack or a rare enemy is near: more damage and mana regeneration for a few seconds (the allies' share is folded into the character's).

def.name: Rallying Roar
def.description: A roar that rallies you: more damage and mana regeneration.

note: A warcry that exerts the next attacks for more damage (modelled as more attack damage while it lasts); the death nova is dropped.

def.name: Kindled Bellow
def.description: A bellow that sets the next blows ablaze: more attack damage and a chance to ignite.

note: A banner that gives more accuracy and the character's speed and damage a lift for as long as it stands (modelled as a timed buff, recast when it ends; the stages are averaged).

def.name: Standard of Valour
def.description: Plants a banner that quickens you while it stands.

note: A banner that makes the character's hits impale and gives a fortifying effect (modelled as a timed buff of impale chance and less damage taken from hits).

def.name: Standard of Dread
def.description: Plants a banner that leaves your hits impaling and your body fortified.
